boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of San Francisco
boards.description: Ten public, under-21-safe food destinations in San Francisco with current late-hours information published by each business.

cards.title: Super Duper Burgers — Laurel Village
cards.subtitle: 3401 California St, San Francisco
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm the day before heading out; this Laurel Village counter lists service through 10:30 PM Thursday–Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Laurel Village burger counter with later Thursday–Sunday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Super Duper Burgers lists its Laurel Village location at 3401 California St and hours until 10:30 PM Thursday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: Laurel Village | Hours + Location | Super Duper
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Mon–Wed 10 AM–10 PM and Thu–Sun 10 AM–10:30 PM; recheck before travel.

cards.title: Super Duper Burgers — Fillmore
cards.subtitle: 1701 Fillmore St, San Francisco
cards.notes: Plan around the posted schedule: the Fillmore restaurant lists midnight closing on Friday and Saturday, with earlier service the rest of the week.
cards.short_summary: A Fillmore restaurant that lists midnight service on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Super Duper Burgers lists its Fillmore location at 1701 Fillmore St and Friday–Saturday hours until 12 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Sun–Thu 10 AM–11 PM and Fri–Sat 10 AM–12 AM; recheck before travel.

cards.title: The Bird — Hayes Valley
cards.subtitle: 406 Hayes St, San Francisco
cards.notes: Check the day-specific schedule before leaving; the Hayes Valley location lists midnight closing on Friday and Saturday and indoor or outdoor seating.
cards.short_summary: A Hayes Valley chicken-sandwich restaurant with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bird lists its Hayes Valley location at 406 Hayes St with Friday and Saturday hours until 12 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Mon–Thu 10:30 AM–11 PM, Fri 10:30 AM–12 AM, Sat 10 AM–12 AM, and Sun 10 AM–11 PM.

cards.title: Nopa
cards.subtitle: 560 Divisadero St, San Francisco
cards.notes: For a seated meal, use the restaurant’s reservation page to check the date; it lists Friday and Saturday service until 11 PM and walk-ins.
cards.short_summary: A Divisadero restaurant listing late Friday and Saturday dinner service.
cards.evidence_claim: Nopa lists its address as 560 Divisadero St and Friday–Saturday hours of 5:30 PM–11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Fri–Sat 5:30 PM–11 PM and says walk-ins are welcome; recheck before travel.

cards.evidence_claim: Super Duper Burgers lists its Irving location at 737 Irving St and Thursday–Sunday hours until 10:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Mon–Wed 10:30 AM–10 PM and Thu–Sun 10:30 AM–10:30 PM; recheck before travel.

cards.evidence_claim: Super Duper Burgers lists its Castro location at 2304 Market St and Thursday–Sunday hours until 11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Mon–Wed 10:30 AM–10:30 PM and Thu–Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM; recheck before travel.

cards.title: Pinecrest Diner
cards.subtitle: 401 Geary St, San Francisco
cards.notes: If you need the latest listed hours, target Wednesday through Saturday; Pinecrest publishes 24-hour service on those days and earlier hours Sunday–Tuesday.
cards.short_summary: A Geary Street diner listing 24-hour Wednesday–Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: Pinecrest Diner lists 401 Geary St and 24-hour hours Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists 24 hours Wed–Sat; Mon–Tue and Sun are listed as 7 AM–11 PM. Recheck before travel.

cards.title: Orphan Andy’s
cards.subtitle: 3991 17th St, San Francisco
cards.notes: Use the diner’s official site to verify service before leaving; it identifies its 17th Street location and states that it is open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A Castro District diner whose official site states 24-hour service.
cards.evidence_claim: Orphan Andy’s official website lists its address as 3991 17th St and says it is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Orphan Andy’s – San Francisco Classic Diner Since 1975
cards.access_notes: Official site states “Open: 24 Hours”; recheck before travel.
